jobs.occupation: Warehouse & Logistics Operator
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring efficient warehouse operations and maintaining high-quality logistics processes? Do you thrive in a structured work environment where you help ensure goods are handled correctly and delivered on time? If so, you may be the Warehouse & Logistics Operator we are looking for!

We offer an exciting opportunity in a company where you will become part of an international supply chain, working with customers such as BMW, Audi, Mercedes, Rolls-Royce and many others. Every day, we are committed to ensuring that our warehouse and logistics processes meet our customers' requirements while supporting efficient production.

As a Warehouse & Logistics Operator, you will play an important role in our daily operations. Your primary responsibilities will include receiving, registering, and dispatching goods while ensuring accurate inventory management and an efficient material flow. You will also contribute to optimizing logistics processes and maintaining high standards of quality, organization, and safety in the warehouse.

Primary Responsibilities

• 
Receive and register incoming goods.

• 
Inspect deliveries and verify quality upon receipt.

• 
Maintain and optimize warehouse organization to ensure efficiency and visibility.

• 
Prepare outbound shipments.

• 
Take responsibility for the day's shipments.

• 
Coordinate daily deliveries and collections with colleagues.

• 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of warehouse procedures and workflows.

• 
Ensure correct packaging and the quality of materials.

• 
Maintain a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

• 
Assist with planning material flow and warehouse optimization. 

We Are Looking for Someone Who

• 
Holds a Category C (Large Goods Vehicle) driving licence. An EU Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC) and a valid driver card are considered an advantage. Truck driving will be a smaller part of the role but is an important qualification.

• 
Has experience in warehouse operations, logistics, or goods receiving.

• 
Works in a structured manner and takes ownership of assigned tasks.

• 
Holds a valid forklift licence/certificate.

• 
Has experience working with ERP systems and is generally comfortable using IT systems.

• 
Is service-minded, flexible, and enjoys working as part of a team.

• 
Can remain organized and maintain an overview, even in a fast-paced

• 
 environment.

• 
Can communicate in Danish, English and/or German.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting position in a company supplying solutions to the automotive industry.

• 
A positive working environment with supportive and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence the development of warehouse operations and working procedures.

• 
A high level of responsibility and autonomy.

• 
A full-time position of 37 hours per week.

• 
Flexible working hours; however, our greatest need for additional staff is between 2:00 PM and 10:00 PM.

Start Date

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible. The vacancy will close once we have found the right candidate.

Interested?

For more information about this position, please contact Patricia Simens Thuesen at patricia.thuesen@alunited.dk.

Please send your application and CV as soon as possible via Jobindex. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: We're Hiring: 2 Ventilation Installers / Diamond Drillers (Training Provided)
jobs.description:
Balling Ventilation – Denmark (Zealand & Funen)

Balling Ventilation is a busy Danish ventilation and contracting company based in Stenløse, working across Zealand (Sjælland) and Funen (Fyn). We install ventilation systems in homes and buildings – from single-room units and heat recovery systems (MVHR) to crawl space ventilation and radon mitigation – and we do a lot of diamond core drilling.

We are growing fast and need 2 new colleagues to start as soon as possible.

Who we're looking for

• 
Bricklayers (murere) who want to learn diamond core drilling and ventilation installation, or

• 
Other skilled trades (carpenters, electricians, plumbers, general construction workers, etc.) who are motivated to learn ventilation work and diamond drilling

No prior ventilation experience required – we will train you. What matters is that you are reliable, hardworking, and want to learn a skilled trade with great long-term prospects.

What we offer

• 
Hourly wage: 180–250 DKK depending on qualifications and experience

• 
+ 12.5% holiday pay (feriepenge) on top of your wage

• 
Your own company van and tools

• 
Plenty of work: minimum 160 hours per month guaranteed – and the opportunity to work 250+ hours per month if you want to, because we are very busy

• 
Full training in ventilation installation and diamond core drilling

• 
Varied work at different sites across Zealand and Funen

Requirements

• 
Skilled trade background (bricklayer or other construction trade)

• 
Willing to relocate to Denmark – we can help by referring you to housing options

• 
Basic English as a minimum (Danish not required)

• 
Valid driver's license

• 
Ready to work hard and learn new skills

How to apply

Send a short message about yourself and your work experience to:

Zakarias Balling Eddaif  ze@ballingventilation.dk  +45 71 72 75 79

We hire on an ongoing basis, so don't wait – reach out today.

jobs.occupation: Køkkenmedhjælper til Det Danske Madhus Albertslund/Kitchen Assistant for Our Production Facility in Albertslund
jobs.description:
Til vores produktion i Albertslund søger vi en struktureret og serviceminded kollega, der trives med at arbejde i et storkøkken, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og god stemning blandt kollegerne er i højsædet. 

Som køkkenmedarbejder hos Det Danske Madhus i Albertslund bliver du en vigtig del af vores team. 
Du får en spændende og varieret hverdag med opgaver såsom: 

• Produktion af kolde og varme retter
• Forefaldende arbejde i køkkenet
• Portionering af retter 
Hos Det Danske Madhus producerer vi dagligt mad til vores mange kunder. Vores kunder omfatter alt fra børn i institutioner og skoler til hjemmeboende ældre eller ældre på plejehjem. Vi mener at alle, uanset alder eller helbred fortjener et velsmagende måltid. 

Vi laver alt mad fra bunden, og opskrifterne er vores egne gennemprøvede opskrifter, så vi ved, vores kunder får måltider af højeste kvalitet. 

Hvem er du? 

Du har gerne tidligere erfaring med at arbejde i et køkken – fx på et hospital eller på et plejehjem. Du arbejder selvstændigt og trives i et miljø hvor der er travlt. 

Du har fokus på god hygiejne og høj kvalitet og du går ikke på kompromis med nogen af tingene. 

Du taler og skriver dansk på højt niveau. 

Hvad kan Det Danske Madhus tilbyde dig?

• Fantastiske kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold 
• Kantineordning med både morgenmad og frokost, der får dig godt igennem dagen 
• Et job omfattet af overenskomst med FOA og Kost og Ernæringsforbundet
• Attraktiv pensionsordning
• En personaleforening der står for hyggelige arrangementer, hvor vi sammen fejrer de små og store succeser
• Overskudsdeling, så du mærker, at din indsats gør en forskel 
Praktiske oplysninger

Du bliver en del af vores produktionsteam i Albertslund, hvor vi er ca. 90 medarbejdere. 

Stillingen er 37 timer pr. uge. Du arbejder mandag til fredag i tidsrummet mellem 6.00-15.00.

Lyder det som noget for dig? 

Så send os dit CV og ansøgning hurtigst muligt via ”ansøg-knappen”

Annoncen er aktiv og vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send dit cv allerede i dag. 

Har du nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Madhuschef Kim Knudsen på mail kik@ddm.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

 

ENGLISH:

For our production facility in Albertslund, we are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who thrives in a large-scale kitchen environment where quality, teamwork, and a positive working atmosphere are top priorities.

As a Kitchen Assistant at Det Danske Madhus in Albertslund, you will become an important part of our team.

You will enjoy an exciting and varied workday with tasks including:

Preparing hot and cold meals
General kitchen duties
Portioning and packaging meals

At Det Danske Madhus, we prepare meals every day for our many customers. Our customers range from children in daycare centres and schools to elderly people living at home or in nursing homes. We believe that everyone, regardless of age or health, deserves a delicious and nutritious meal.

All our food is made from scratch using our own tried and tested recipes, ensuring that our customers receive meals of the highest quality.

Who Are You?

Ideally, you have previous experience working in a kitchen environment, for example in a hospital, nursing home, or similar setting.

You are able to work independently and thrive in a busy workplace.

You have a strong focus on hygiene and quality, and you never compromise on either.

You are fluent in spoken and written Danish.

What Can Det Danske Madhus Offer You?
Fantastic colleagues and a strong sense of team spirit
A staff canteen offering both breakfast and lunch to keep you energized throughout the day
Employment covered by collective agreements with FOA and The Danish Association of Dietitians and Nutrition Professionals
An attractive pension scheme
A staff association that organizes social events where we celebrate both small and large successes together
A profit-sharing scheme, ensuring that you feel the impact of your contribution
Practical Information

You will become part of our production team in Albertslund, consisting of approximately 90 employees.

This is a full-time position (37 hours per week). Working hours are Monday to Friday between 6:00 AM and 3:00 PM.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

Then send us your CV and application as soon as possible via the "Apply" button.

The position is open, and we review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV today.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Kitchen Manager Kim Knudsen at kik@ddm.dk.

jobs.occupation: Executive Thai Chef assistant
jobs.description:
Role Description

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Thai chef to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Thai dishes while ensuring high standards of quality, consistency, and presentation. You will work closely with the kitchen team to maintain an efficient workflow and uphold food safety regulations.

Qualifications

• 
At least 3 years of experience in a Thai cooking

• 
Strong culinary skills and expertise in food preparation techniques

• 
Experience in maintaining food quality and consistency

• 
Keen attention to detail and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• 
Excellent communication and teamwork skills

• 
Solid understanding of food safety and sanitation regulations

• 
Prior experience in a similar role is a plus

• 
Culinary certification or relevant education preferred

• 
Able to communicate effectively in English at an A2 proficiency level or higher. A valid test certificate is required as proof

 

 

About Wokshop

Wokshop – A Bite of Thailand is all about authentic Thai flavors, fresh ingredients, and a relaxed dining experience. Since opening our doors in 2000, we’ve grown to 13 restaurants, each offering both dine-in and takeaway, bringing the taste of Thailand to more people every day.

jobs.occupation: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland
jobs.description:
Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

You are a qualified carpenter

You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

You have a valid driving licence

You can communicate in English

Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

Pension scheme

Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write "Bonde Glas" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

As a driver at Dag Log, you will handle a variety of transport tasks, including distribution, pickup and delivery, and potentially longer-distance routes, depending on your qualifications and operational needs.

Execution of planned transport assignments with a strong focus on on-time delivery and high service quality

jobs.occupation: Er du massør med passion for dit fag? Bliv en del af CityFys i Kalundborg! Are you a massage therapist with a passion for your profession? Join CityFys in Kalundborg!
jobs.description:
Hos CityFys søger vi en engageret og dygtig massør til vores virksomhedsordninger i Kalundborg – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring! Vi er på udkig efter en passioneret massør, der ønsker at arbejde i et udviklende og støttende miljø, hvor du kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Hvorfor CityFys?

Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Faste og attraktive behandlingsdage i CityFys’ virksomhedsordninger og i egen klinik

• 
Mulighed for ekstra vikaropgaver og fleksible timer

• 
Gratis og løbende efteruddannelse, herunder kurser i triggerpunkter, ergonomi, stretching og meget mere. Læs om kurserne her: CityFys kurser

• 
Fordelagtige vilkår, inklusiv fitness- og sundhedsordning

• 
Fleksibel aflønning – enten per faktura eller som dataløn

• 
Løbende support og sparring, så du kan udvikle dig i dit tempo

Er du klar til at tage din karriere som massør til næste niveau?

Send din ansøgning via vores hjemmeside: http://cityfys.dk/søg-job/  
Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til os på tlf. 70 200 726.

CityFys A/S er Danmarks største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen København og Water & Wellness Randers.

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.occupation: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
• Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
• Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
• Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
• Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.
Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
• Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
• Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
• Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
• Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
• A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
